GenAiFunction.description: 🎯 PROGRAM DISCOVERY V5 - Search Product Catalog (172 global programs) and Regional Programs (861 local programs). 🔍 REQUIRED: searchTerm="Agentforce", programType="BOTH"|"GLOBAL"|"REGIONAL". ✅ FLEXIBLE INPUT: includeUsageMetrics accepts true/"true"/"yes"/"1", limit accepts 50/"50", includeArchived accepts false/"false"/"no"/"0". Examples: {"searchTerm":"Tableau","programType":"BOTH","limit":"50","includeUsageMetrics":"true"} OR {"searchTerm":"Tableau","programType":"BOTH","limit":50,"includeUsageMetrics":true}. Both work! Returns programs with smart synonym expansion, usage metrics (enrollment, learners, recent delivery), and comprehensive filtering by enablement type, level, role, region, session type, business priority, duration.
